name: Scattered Spider
description: Scattered Spider is an English-speaking cybercrime group, part of The Com network, that extorted at least $115 million from victims. The group primarily uses social engineering, SIM swapping, and corrupting corporate insiders rather than technical exploits — offering employees up to $20,000/week for inside access. Major attacks include MGM Resorts and Caesars Entertainment (2023), Transport for London, and UK retailers Marks & Spencer and Harrods. Several core members, many teenagers, pleaded guilty in 2026.

sources.title: Scattered Spider Hackers Plead Guilty on Day 1 of Trial — Krebs on Security
